== Notes ==

* Posted TIGIH dested There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him; CCF dested Colo Claw Fish; COR: JCC dested Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber; H1 db dested Home One: Docking Bay; Endor db dested Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay).
* Posted Screaming Lando dested Lando Calrissian, Scoundrel (the card image shows Lando shouting); Angry Chewie dested Chewie, Enraged; EPP Han dested Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; Threeps w/ parts dested Threepio With His Parts Showing.
* Original-era (V) cards dested to the newest printing legal on 2004-01-26 (Princess Leia (V), Keep Your Eyes Open (V), Imperial Atrocity (V), Bionic Hand (V) to Virtual Set 6).

== Strategy ==

Run it like TRM. ICFTC is huge in TRM. The deck’s not exactly force choke, but if your opponent doesn’t get many icons of his own accord, it could function that way, especially with Goo out. No SAC- not with four sevens and not enough deck space. I’m looking for more Rebel Artilleries. No backup Luke- I could care less if he dies, even in the unlikely event he does, what with Fallen Portal and Bionic Hand (V). I don’t have any retrieval, which could be a problem, I was thinking about podracing, but I don’t have a system to control, nor space.

Against a space deck just set down and drain at the Back Door and Landing platform, supplemented with Rebel Artillery and Lightsaber Proficiency. You’re pretty sunk, though.
